observation_kind: targeted official endpoint and transport diagnostics; not independent bulk HTTP fetches
rules: The official download page reports publication on 5 July 2026.
New INSPIRE files are published on the first Sunday of every month.
London Borough of Barnet is present in the current local-authority download list.
London Borough of Enfield is present in the current local-authority download list.
The page states that GIS software is required to view the downloaded polygons.
Exact Barnet and Enfield asset hrefs were not exposed through the available redirect-looping web view.
Current Barnet and Enfield GML bytes and cryptographic hashes were not captured.
Current INSPIRE IDs and native-BNG containment for the candidate point remain unresolved.
The entity endpoint documents reference as an optional array of strings.
The q parameter is documented for postcode or UPRN search rather than title-boundary reference search.
Entity search supports JSON, HTML and GeoJSON response formats.
Latitude and longitude queries return entities whose geometries cover the constructed point.
Official guidance warns that no result does not prove no constraint because coverage varies.
The exact current response for this candidate reference could not be read back.
The exact current title-boundary coordinate-intersection response could not be read back.
An authoritative UPRN binding for the candidate remains unavailable.
The official announcement lists the persistent LIDAR Composite DTM 1m WCS endpoint.
The listed capabilities request uses WCS version 2.0.1.
The official guidance describes WCS as the route for raw pixel data such as elevation.
The exact capabilities request responded as application/xml in the web transport.
WCS GeoTIFF NoData pixels are documented as -3.4028235e+38.
The XML body could not be parsed by the available web transport, so the coverage identifier remains unresolved.
Exact TQ2892 coverage bytes and candidate pixel values remain unavailable.
The source-survey record used for the candidate pixel remains unavailable.
OS Terrain 50 is supplied as an online download with no registration required.
The national tiled supply contains 2,858 10km tiles arranged in 55 100km grid-square folders.
Each grid tile contains 200 rows and 200 columns.
Grid pixels are 50m by 50m and heights are supplied to the nearest 0.1m.
The grid creation method means adjacent tiles have neither overlaps nor common edge values.
The exact Terrain50 area=TQ API response could not be opened by the safe-URL web transport.
Current TQ29 archive bytes, nested file list and hashes remain unavailable.
The actual Terrain 50 target cells for the candidate remain unavailable.

web_transport_evidence.hmlr_download_page: Current 5 July 2026 release and Barnet/Enfield listings were visible in official search retrieval; opening the page triggered a redirect loop.
web_transport_evidence.planning_exact_queries: Documentation exposed the reference filter and endpoint contract; exact parameter-mutated candidate URLs were rejected by the safe-URL transport and exact-reference web searches returned no result.
web_transport_evidence.ea_wcs_capabilities: The official DTM 1m GetCapabilities link was followed and returned application/xml; the web parser rejected the XML body as unsupported content.
web_transport_evidence.os_exact_download: The official product/supply/grid contracts were readable; the exact parameterized Terrain50 area=TQ API URL was rejected by the safe-URL transport.

promotion.reason: Exact HMLR authority assets/native-BNG containment, Planning candidate responses/UPRNs, EA WCS coverage body/TQ2892 pixels/source survey, OS TQ29 archive/cells and shared F-host revision14 receipts remain absent.
